item.title: Why a Push for Natural Law Among Christians? [God, Law, and Liberty]
item.description: There is renewed interest in natural law among Christians as a means of supporting legal and public policy positions in the public square. But why? David suggests that if we understand how the conversation changed from the days of Thomas Aquinas, we might not be so keen on the idea. To properly evaluate the merits of natural law's reasoning process, Sons of Issachar must understand the nature of the conversation taking place among our thought leaders--on the airwaves, in capitols, and in courtrooms.
